reference_repair.finding: Historical CUDA.jl genuinely implements both native grid-stride kernels and fully zero-initializes its CPU column reference. Native eval mallocs its CPU column reference without initializing the oversized unused allocation suffix, then memcmps the full allocation against zero-initialized GPU columns. Study initializes all physical buffers and preserves both original native kernels and both genuine CUDA.jl kernel bodies. This is a host-validator initialization scope, not evidence of a wrong native device operator.
reference_repair.native_physical_memory_scope: Volumeallocation630 values contains210 logical contiguous values plus420 unused tail values, not a halo-strided tensor. Bothkernels use logical depth3height5width7; allunusedphysicaltails explicitly checked.
reference_repair.column_shape_scope: Explicit depth_col3height_col5width_col7 retained as supplied; source does not derive standard convolution outputshape. Native CLI uses same spatial extents too.
reference_repair.backward_range_scope: Source eval passes forward n to backward; it equals actual logical volume count for original and both measured configurations. Arbitrary unequal column-volume ranges unmeasured.
